issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation 'cũng vậy' (also/likewise) at the end of the sentence creates a logical disconnect. The Greek text states that God gave the Holy Spirit to those who obey Him. The Vietnamese phrasing suggests that 'the Holy Spirit' is also a witness or shares the same status as 'we', which is not in the Greek. The Greek structure is: 'And we are witnesses... and God gave the Holy Spirit to those who obey Him.'
